model_claims.text: When monkeypatch.setenv is called with a prepend argument and the environment variable exists but is empty, no trailing separator is added; the result is just the value.
model_claims.source_quote: Don't add a trailing separator in `monkeypatch.setenv(prepend=...)` when the variable is empty

model_claims.text: If the variable exists but is empty, monkeypatch.setenv(name, value, prepend=sep) used to leave value + sep.
model_claims.source_quote: If the variable exists but is empty, `monkeypatch.setenv(name, value, prepend=sep)` used to leave `value + sep`.

model_claims.text: If the variable exists but is empty, monkeypatch.setenv(name, value, prepend=sep) now leaves value.
The change does not affect behavior when the variable is unset or has a non-empty value.
model_claims.source_quote: It does not change anything when the variable is unset or has a value.

model_claims.text: A variable whose value consists only of spaces is still considered to have a value and is not treated as empty.
model_claims.source_quote: A value made only of spaces still counts as a value, so it is not treated as empty.
